name: Yonex Voltric Z-Force II badminton racket ( Master Copy )
description:
Yonex Voltric Z-Force II Badminton Racket

Brand: Yonex
Model: Voltric Z-Force II
Type: Badminton Racket Bat
Flex: Extra Stiff
Shaft: H.M. Graphite with NANOMETRIC technology
Frame: H.M. Graphite with Tungsten
Weight / Grip Size:

3U: Avg. 88g (G4, G5)
Stringing Advice: 20–28 lbs
Balance: Head-Heavy (for maximum smash power)
Features:

Tri-Voltage System: Combines power, speed, and control

Ultra-stiff shaft for explosive smashes

Heavy head for attacking play while maintaining maneuverability

Lightweight design for fast swing speed

Ideal for advanced and professional players

Highlights:

Designed for aggressive attacking style

Delivers unmatched power and precision

Ergonomic handle for comfortable grip
